name: cGZCOM::CreateGuid (slot 7)
notes: Lane EN. Hooked through cGZCOMAdapters::CreateGuid. Under the lock: waits in quarter seconds (0x1b9f95, SleepEx) while _time64 is below the stored time (64-bit compare against the sign-extended word), then (RandomUint32Uniform(8) << 29) | (SecondsSinceGuidEpoch() & 0x1fffffff); stores time + 1. The stored time 0x7fffffff with a clock below it is left out: it waits about 2^31 s in both. Mutants (lane EN): unsigned compare, <=, Uniform(7), 30-bit mask, stored time from the first read, +2, unlock removed, other wait: killed. Byte match given up 2026-11-04: the clock reads go through the seed control's seams (gGZCOMGuidTimeOverride, gGZCOMGuidSecondsOverride), so verified by the difftest; coordinator mutants 4/4 killed on the seams.
